blocks.text: Built around the anniversary line “It started with one spoon,” the celebration brings together 10 days of nationwide offers, a 10 Destinations Anniversary Getaway Raffle, and Spoon to School, an initiative that gives customers another way to reuse llaollao’s familiar green spoon. One spoon. Ten years. 110 stores. Since entering the Philippine market, llaollao has become part of everyday routines—from after-school and after-work stops to weekend mall visits, family outings and barkada meetups.
